in_marathi.name: Udbhavi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Udbhavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘udbhav’, meaning ‘awakened’ or ‘emerged’. This name symbolizes the idea of new beginnings, growth, and rebirth. In Hindu mythology, Udbhavi is a name for the goddess Lakshmi, who represents prosperity, wealth, and abundance.
